ZEUSANCIENT-AIR_QUALITY.title: Air Quality
ZEUSANCIENT-AIR_QUALITY.description: Whenever you would deal [blue]{DamageThreshold}[/blue] or less unblocked attack damage, increase it to [blue]{DamageMinimum}[/blue].
ZEUSANCIENT-DOUBLE_STRIKE.title: Double Strike
ZEUSANCIENT-DOUBLE_STRIKE.description: Upon pickup, enchant ALL cards containing "Strike" in your [gold]Deck[/gold] with [purple]Double[/purple].
ZEUSANCIENT-ELECTRIC_OVERLOAD.title: Electric Overload
ZEUSANCIENT-ELECTRIC_OVERLOAD.descriptio: Gain {Energy:energyIcons()} at the start of each turn. At the end of your turn, take [blue]{Damage:diff()}[/blue] damage for each unspent Energy.
ZEUSANCIENT-HEAVEN_FLOURISH.title: Heaven Flourish
ZEUSANCIENT-HEAVEN_FLOURISH.description: The first [blue]2[/blue] Skills you play each combat are played an extra time.
ZEUSANCIENT-HEAVEN_STRIKE.title: Heaven Strike
ZEUSANCIENT-HEAVEN_STRIKE.description: Whenever you deal unblocked attack damage, apply [gold]Blitz[/gold].
ZEUSANCIENT-IONIC_GAIN.title: Ionic Gain
ZEUSANCIENT-IONIC_GAIN.description: Every [blue]2nd[/blue] turn, add [blue]{Cards}[/blue] [gold]Aether Font[/gold] into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
ZEUSANCIENT-STATIC_SHOCK.title: Static Shock
ZEUSANCIENT-STATIC_SHOCK.description: Whenever you deal unblocked attack damage to an enemy, deal [blue]{PercentDamage}%[/blue] of that damage to a different random enemy. If there are no other enemies, deal it to the original target instead.
ZEUSANCIENT-STORM_RING.title: Storm Ring
ZEUSANCIENT-STORM_RING.description: Gain {Energy:energyIcons()} at the start of each turn. Whenever you play a card that targets an enemy, you must target that enemy until it dies.
